digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and create dispatch
propositions: DC Lucene index eventual consistency causes JQL searches to miss recently-created unindexed issues, allowing recover_pending to incorrectly unbind a keyless-pending binding whose issue exists but is not yet indexed

a crash during create followed by an index-lag miss causes recover_pending to unbind, then dispatch_one.create_one to issue a second create and write a duplicate Jira issue because its dedup search also misses the unindexed first issue

recover_pending's keyless-pending branch must track search misses and defer unbinding until a search_miss_count threshold is reached AND the entry exceeds a grace period, leaving the binding pending to gate the create
dispatch_one.create_one must gate the create on keyless-pendingness within the grace window, not only on absent jira_key, so the deferred create is held while the index catches up
